# Interface methods are enumerated from the interface body.
exec gorelo coverage -for IDB 'Test*'
stdout 'IDB.*2 of 2 entries reach 2 of 2 methods'
stdout 'TestIfaceGet.*Get'
stdout 'TestIfaceBoth.*Get, Put'

# By-method view lists tests under each interface method.
exec gorelo coverage -for IDB --by-method 'Test*'
stdout 'Get +2 entries'
stdout 'Put +1 entry'

# Method-narrow form works for interfaces.
exec gorelo coverage -for 'IDB#Get' 'Test*'
stdout 'IDB#Get'
stdout 'TestIfaceGet.*Get'
stdout 'TestIfaceBoth.*Get'

# Method-glob form works for interfaces.
exec gorelo coverage -for 'IDB#P*' 'Test*'
stdout 'IDB#P\*'
stdout 'TestIfaceBoth.*Put'
! stdout 'TestIfaceGet'

# Empty interface is rejected with the same error as a struct with no methods.
! exec gorelo coverage -for Empty 'Test*'
stderr 'has no methods'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/test

go 1.21
-- db.go --
package main

type IDB interface {
	Get() string
	Put(s string)
}

type Empty interface{}

type fakeDB struct{}

func (f *fakeDB) Get() string  { return "" }
func (f *fakeDB) Put(s string) {}

func newIDB() IDB { return &fakeDB{} }
-- db_test.go --
package main

import "testing"

func TestIfaceGet(t *testing.T) {
	db := newIDB()
	_ = db.Get()
}

func TestIfaceBoth(t *testing.T) {
	db := newIDB()
	_ = db.Get()
	db.Put("x")
}
